symptom: Control-plane pages that started emitting classed HTML (hosted-page.ts, github.ts, workos-browser-sessions.ts) failed pnpm check:ui as class names compiled by nothing; the push had run only lint and the secret scan.
rule: When server code emits classed HTML styled by its own inline stylesheet, name those files in SOURCE_EXEMPT with the reason rather than adding an @source, and run every AGENTS.md handoff gate before each push.
